answer: Keep it small: each agent signs two edges per epoch, edges halve every 30 days, and standing is capped at one share per identity per epoch. A cluster of new identities that only sign each other builds a violet island of edges with no path to the main graph, so its weight rounds to nothing. Idle agents bleed standing until the edge is gone, and a basalt block of new accounts with no outside edge never gets through. Cost of faking a member: two live outside signatures per epoch, forever, plus a bond.
